shortDescription: Waits for a condition before continuing

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for a connection to happen before closing and retrying.

options.name: delay
options.description: The number of seconds to wait before starting to poll.

options.name: exclude_hosts
options.description: The list of hosts or IPs to ignore when looking for active TCP connections when C(state=drained).

options.name: host
options.description: A resolvable hostname or IP address to wait for. If C(state=drained) then it will only check for connections on the IP specified, you can use '0.0.0.0' to use all host IPs.

options.name: path
options.description: The path to a file on the filesystem to check. If C(state) is present or started then it will wait until the file exists. If C(state) is absent then it will wait until the file does not exist.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number to poll on C(host).

options.name: regex
options.description: Can be used to match a string in a file. If C(state) is present or started then it will wait until the regex matches. If C(state) is absent then it will wait until the regex does not match. Defaults to a multiline regex.

options.name: sleep
options.description: Number of seconds to sleep between checks.

options.name: state
options.description: When checking a port, C(started) will ensure the port is open, C(stopped) will check that is it closed and C(drained) will check for active connections. When checking for a file or a search string C(present) or C(started) will ensure that the file or string is present, C(absent) will check that the file or search string is absent or removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The maximum number of seconds to wait for.
